Class DeepTimePaleoEpochGenerator

java.lang.Object
org.ether.society.data.DeepTimePaleoEpochGenerator
public final class DeepTimePaleoEpochGenerator extends Object

DeepTimePaleoEpochGenerator

Generates academic cartographic rasters (25-layer tensor suite), 1D initial state vectors, and scientific metadata for deep Paleolithic and Pleistocene planetary epochs:

  • -3,000,000 BP: Late Pliocene Australopithecus Cradle (Afar, Turkana, South Africa)
  • -2,000,000 BP: Early Pleistocene Homo erectus Out of Africa I (Dmanisi, Sangiran, Nihewan)
  • -1,000,000 BP: Early/Mid-Pleistocene Acheulean Expansion (Africa, Southern Europe, Asia)
  • -300,000 BP: Middle Paleolithic Archaic Sapiens invalid input: '&' Neanderthal Dispersal (Jebel Irhoud)
